# vendor/raygui — raygui (linked as C, not ported)

`raygui.h` copied verbatim from `/home/rajesh/opensource/graphics/raylib-6.2/examples/shapes/raygui.h`
(raygui v5.1-dev, as bundled with the raylib 6.2 examples; every bundled copy is identical).
zlib/libpng license — see the header.

raygui is a separate immediate-mode GUI library built on raylib, not part of
raylib itself. Like `vendor/raylib/src/external/`, it is **linked as C**
(`src/c/raygui_impl.c` instantiates it); the Zig binding `src/raygui/` is
generated by `tools/gen_raygui.py`.
